012221211200201000001111022021020 - ASI: 24

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  02 = 0 * 2
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  020 = 0 * 20
  122 = 12 * 2
  0000 = 00 * 00
  0122 = 0 * 122
  0220 = 02 * 20
  1111 = 11 * 11
  1200 = 12 * 00
  2010 = 20 * 10
  2121 = 21 * 21
  21020 = 21 * 020
  00001111 = 0000 * 1111
  01222121 = 0122 * 2121
  12002010 = 1200 * 2010
  022021020 = 0220 * 21020
  0122212112002010 = 01222121 * 12002010
  00001111022021020 = 00001111 * 022021020
  012221211200201000001111022021020 = 0122212112002010 * 00001111022021020
